name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: The Ranger has a higher gold than Wrenna.
The Gnome's gold is at least 10 gp more than the adventurer with the Wolf familiar.
The adventurer with the Owl familiar's gold is between Kael and the Gnome.
Toad goes with at most one of Lyra, Half-Orc, Wizard, and 45 gp.
The adventurer with the Toad familiar's gold is between Sable and the Gnome.
The adventurer with the Toad familiar's gold is exactly 10 gp more than the Druid.
The Elf's gold is immediately below the Wizard.
